newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish budget will take CPI into account - FinMin.
newsitem.headline: Swedish budget will take CPI into account - FinMin.

text.p: Sweden's Finance Minister Erik Asbrink said on Friday that unexpected falls in consumer prices would be factored into a budget proposal, due to be released on April 15.

"The development of CPI has been a surprise to most people. That can indicate an even lower tendency to inflation in Swedish economy than we were expecting. Of course we will take this into account before we finalise the budget calculations for April 15," Asbrink told journalists in parliament.
He added that the low CPI figures should also give a strong foundation to coming wage negotiations.
Consumer prices fell 0.1 percent in February from January, while the market expected an increase of around 0.2 percent, according to a Reuter poll.
